title: Create: Horizons
description: Create Horizons is an exploration-focused Minecraft modpack built around Minecraft and the incredible engineering possibilities of the Create Mod ecosystem.
body:
Create: Horizons is an exploration-focused Minecraft modpack built around Minecraft and the incredible engineering possibilities of the Create Mod ecosystem.

Build massive flying machines with Create Aeronautics, discover breathtaking landscapes generated by Tectonic, and explore an endless world enhanced by Distant Horizons, new biomes, countless structures, and immersive world generation improvements.

With performance optimization mods for a smoother experience and a world designed to reward adventure, Create Horizons combines industrial creativity, aerial exploration, and epic scenery into one seamless journey above the clouds.
